Michos, MD, MHS, FAHA, FACC, FASE, FASPC, is an associate professor of medicine in the division of cardiology at Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, USA, with a joint appointment in the Department of Epidemiology at the Bloomberg School of Public Health. She is the director of women’s car￾diovascular health and associate director of preventive car￾diology with the Johns Hopkins Ciccarone Center for the Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease. Dr. Michos is an internationally known expert in preven￾tive cardiology and has authored over 550 publications and 10 book chapters. Her research has focused on: (i) cardiovascular disease among women, (ii) coronary artery calcium and in￾flammatory markers, (iii) lipids, and (iv) diabetes and cardio￾metabolic disease. biographic and disclosure information www.kidney-international.org
